t: Using Hiera with Puppet | Linux Journal
s: The idea behind separating code and data is more than just having a cleaner Puppet environment; it allows engineers to create more re-usable Puppet modules. It also puts your variables in one place so that they too can be re-used, without importing manifests across modules. Hiera's use cases include managing packages and versions or using it as a Node Classifier.
